title.narrative: STEG: Tax Capacity and Cost of Collection: Evidence from Local Governments in Ghana

description.narrative: The project aims to understand how the cost of tax collection affects the ability of local governments in Ghana to collect property taxes. In particular, it examines whether investments in technology can reduce collection costs and improve the effectiveness of property tax collection. More broadly, the research seeks to understand how stronger and more efficient local tax capacity can help governments finance essential public goods and services.
